# StrongestLayer - reasoning-led email security candidate (2026-11-05)

**Canonical entity:** StrongestLayer, https://www.strongestlayer.com/  
**Stage:** Researched, human review pending; vendor-published claims only. **Primary category:** `email-security`.

**Vendor-published product:** TRACE uses multiple reasoning engines and organizational context to examine message intent, sender behavior and payment workflows. Company advertises API connection to Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace with no MX changes, a ~30-second verdict and structured SOC evidence export. Neither recall nor response time distribution independently tested here. [How TRACE works](https://www.strongestlayer.com/platform/how-it-works)

**Public commercial signal:** custom quote scales with mailbox count; vendor advertises 14-day POC and lists Advisor, Triage and Hunt agents. Its [partner page](https://www.strongestlayer.com/company/partners) separately advertises the full platform without module gating and explicitly recruits MSPs/MSSPs/VARs. No price per mailbox or service-provider margin is published in the source. [Pricing](https://www.strongestlayer.com/get-pricing)

**Hypothesis:** useful where buyers demand auditable reasoning and where payment diversion is the material risk. Falsify by comparing investigator trust, blind true/false positives, explanation quality, timing of action and analyst effort with current controls.

**Unknown:** independent effectiveness; exact exposure window despite API/no MX; self-hosting and geographic limits, account-takeover scope, SOC integration edition, data processing contractual terms, MSSP tenant isolation, delegated admin and reseller pricing.

**Questions:** Show median and p95 time from delivery to enforceable remediation; a disputed verdict and rollback; permitted scopes and subprocessor/residency; pricing for shared/seasonal mailboxes and MSP scale.

**Editorial recheck (2026-11-06):** product, pricing and partner pages inspected. Original pricing URL now redirects to https://www.strongestlayer.com/pricing; retain the original link for provenance. Partner-program existence is supported, but tenant administration, isolation and contracted economics remain Unknown. Public SaaS positioning does not verify region-specific processing; the cited product page no longer establishes AWS US inference.

**Source state:** official vendor product and pricing pages, published dates Unknown, observed 2026-11-05. **Next review:** 2026-12-05. **Owner/reviewer:** repository maintainer / unassigned. **Rights:** brief paraphrase and links.
